mapper.sql: WITH RECURSIVE visible_scope (organization_unit_id, include_descendants) AS ( SELECT scope_target_id, include_descendants FROM seal.user_scope WHERE admin_user_id = #{actorId} AND scope_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND active = TRUE UNION SELECT child.organization_unit_id, TRUE FROM seal.organization_unit child JOIN visible_scope parent_scope ON child.parent_id = parent_scope.organization_unit_id WHERE parent_scope.include_descendants = TRUE )
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE visible_scope (organization_unit_id, include_descendants) AS ( SELECT scope_target_id, include_descendants FROM seal.user_scope WHERE admin_user_id = #{adminUserId} AND scope_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND active = TRUE UNION SELECT child.organization_unit_id, TRUE FROM seal.organization_unit child JOIN visible_scope parent_scope ON child.parent_id = parent_scope.organization_unit_id WHERE parent_scope.include_descendants = TRUE ) SELECT DISTINCT user_account.admin_user_id, user_account.login_id, user_account.display_name, organization.organization_name, user_account.account_status, user_account.consecutive_failures, user_account.locked_until, user_account.last_login_at FROM seal.admin_user user_account JOIN visible_scope scope ON scope.organization_unit_id = user_account.organization_unit_id JOIN seal.organization_unit organization ON organization.organization_unit_id = user_account.organization_unit_id ORDER BY user_account.display_name, user_account.login_id

SELECT user_account.admin_user_id, user_account.login_id, user_account.display_name, user_account.organization_unit_id, organization.organization_name, user_account.account_status, user_account.consecutive_failures, user_account.locked_until, user_account.must_change_password, user_account.version_no FROM seal.admin_user user_account JOIN visible_scope scope ON scope.organization_unit_id = user_account.organization_unit_id JOIN seal.organization_unit organization ON organization.organization_unit_id = user_account.organization_unit_id WHERE user_account.admin_user_id = #{adminUserId}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible_scope WHERE organization_unit_id = #{organizationUnitId})
SELECT count(*) FROM seal.admin_role WHERE active = TRUE AND role_id IN #{roleId, jdbcType=OTHER}

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM seal.user_role assignment JOIN seal.admin_role role ON role.role_id = assignment.role_id WHERE assignment.admin_user_id = #{adminUserId} AND assignment.active = TRUE AND role.active = TRUE AND role.role_code = 'SYSTEM_ADMIN' )

SELECT count(DISTINCT user_account.admin_user_id) FROM seal.admin_user user_account JOIN seal.user_role assignment ON assignment.admin_user_id = user_account.admin_user_id AND assignment.active = TRUE JOIN seal.admin_role role ON role.role_id = assignment.role_id AND role.active = TRUE AND role.role_code = 'SYSTEM_ADMIN' WHERE user_account.account_status <> 'INACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seal.admin_user (admin_user_id, login_id, display_name, organization_unit_id, password_hash, account_status, must_change_password, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{adminUserId}, #{loginId}, #{displayName}, #{organizationUnitId}, #{passwordHash}, 'ACTIVE', TRUE, #{actorId}, #{actorId})

INSERT INTO seal.user_role (admin_user_id, role_id, assigned_by, active) VALUES
(#{adminUserId}, #{roleId, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{actorId}, TRUE)
ON CONFLICT (admin_user_id, role_id) DO UPDATE SET active = TRUE, assigned_by = EXCLUDED.assigned_by, assigned_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, revoked_at = NULL, revoked_by = NULL

INSERT INTO seal.user_scope (user_scope_id, admin_user_id, scope_type, scope_target_id, include_descendants, assigned_by, active) VALUES
(gen_random_uuid(), #{adminUserId}, 'ORGANIZATION', #{scopeId, jdbcType=OTHER}, TRUE, #{actorId}, TRUE)
ON CONFLICT (admin_user_id, scope_type, scope_target_id) DO UPDATE SET active = TRUE, include_descendants = TRUE, assigned_by = EXCLUDED.assigned_by, assigned_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, revoked_at = NULL, revoked_by = NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE seal.admin_user SET display_name = #{displayName}, organization_unit_id = #{organizationUnitId}, account_status = #{accountStatus}, updated_by = #{actorId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version_no = version_no + 1 WHERE admin_user_id = #{adminUserId} AND version_no = #{versionNo}

UPDATE seal.admin_user SET account_status = 'ACTIVE', consecutive_failures = 0, locked_until = NULL, updated_by = #{actorId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version_no = version_no + 1 WHERE admin_user_id = #{adminUserId} AND version_no = #{versionNo}

UPDATE seal.admin_user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, must_change_password = TRUE, account_status = 'ACTIVE', consecutive_failures = 0, locked_until = NULL, updated_by = #{actorId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version_no = version_no + 1 WHERE admin_user_id = #{adminUserId} AND version_no = #{versionNo}
mapper.select: SELECT role_id FROM seal.user_role WHERE admin_user_id = #{adminUserId} AND active = TRUE ORDER BY role_id
SELECT scope_target_id FROM seal.user_scope WHERE admin_user_id = #{adminUserId} AND scope_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND active = TRUE ORDER BY scope_target_id
